args.summary: The latest deploy of checkout-api (v2.3.1) failed health checks in production. A rollback to the most recent release healthy in production was required. v2.3.0 was initially targeted but is quarantined (CVE-2026-4417), so the service was rolled back to v2.2.9 instead, successfully rolled out across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Post-rollback service status should be monitored; v2.3.0 unquarantine and root cause of the v2.3.1 health check failures need follow-up.
args.title: checkout-api rolled back to v2.2.9 after health check failures on v2.3.1

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened:

1. **Investigated**: The latest deploy, **v2.3.1**, was unhealthy in production; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **First rollback attempt failed**: v2.3.0 is quarantined due to **CVE-2026-4417**, so it could not be used.
3. **Rolled back to v2.2.9** (the next most recent release healthy in production) — successfully rolled out across all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west.
4. **Verified**: checkout-api is now healthy on v2.2.9 with a low error rate (0.2%).
5. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** and paged on-call, documenting the rollback, the quarantine of v2.3.0, and follow-ups (unquarantine/remediation of v2.3.0, root cause of v2.3.1's health check failures).

transcript.reasoning_content: Rollback succeeded in all regions. Verify health, then open SEV2 incident.
